_doc: The townspeople's Pokémon's bodies (creature_doduo.gd, creature_caterpie.gd). Doduo: duty = the part of a step cycle a foot is planted (walk / run), foot_w half the stance, ankle_h. Caterpie: step_w the part of a cycle a joint steps, delay between joints, settle (cycles/s to finish a wave), up_idle / up_crawl the front's lean (radians). Their speeds are in native/life/companions.json.
